researchTasks: [High] Australian availability, age pathway, model disclosure and retention: Please confirm current Australian school availability, exact under-18 consent pathway, model/provider names, platform retention and school administrator visibility. (route: Khan Academy institutional partnerships; evidence wanted: School/district terms, privacy policy, DPA, product security pack)
Age is context-dependent: adult individual registration, under-18 access through guardian/district. Confirm exact age handling by market and configuration; verify model names and output ownership.

Ask vendor (Trains AI models on customer data): Is customer data used to train, fine-tune, evaluate or improve foundation models or classifiers? Please distinguish opt-in, opt-out and default behaviour.
Ask vendor (AI models used): Please identify the current model names/version or state explicitly that models are proprietary/in-house or not disclosed. Please map models to AI features.
Ask vendor (Staff can set limits on the AI): Can school administrators access all learner transcripts, and what role-based controls are available?
Ask vendor (Answers from your own course content): Can the AI answer from customer-provided course content or institutional knowledge? Can this be restricted to approved content?
Ask vendor (Shows its sources): Does the AI show citations or source references for answers grounded in uploaded/course content?
Ask vendor (Who owns what the AI produces): Who owns generated courses, questions, feedback, assessments and learner outputs? What licence does your company retain?
Researcher note (learnerOversight), not shown until sourced: Moderation detects potentially harmful/unsafe interactions and alerts connected adults; parents can review chat transcripts.

Researcher note (learnerOversight), not shown until sourced: Individual registrants must be 18+. Under-18s can use only through parent/guardian-linked child account, district partnership or specified teacher-assigned writing coach pathway.

Researcher note (outputOwnership), not shown until sourced: Under-18 access requires parent/guardian linkage or district partnership; child chat histories can be reviewed by connected adults. Khan Academy advises not to submit PII.
